Chapter 6709: Ultimate Divine Beast, Chaos

Chapter 6709: Ultimate Divine Beast, Chaos

Chaos’ gift struck the heavenly body, sending it back to the present where it was reachable. This exceeded everyone’s logic and knowledge of power.

“Chaos power...” Desolate Ancestor pondered silently.

Bao Pu was one of the few who saw the exchange. However, despair enveloped him. He surpassed numerous peerless geniuses and could be considered a sage of cultivation.

He reached a great height, having met numerous immortals including the primordial ones. Thus, his life goal was to become a primordial immortal.

However, this battle shattered his perspective and goal. He believed the primordial realm was the highest, capable of ruling all worlds. Now, he learned about celestial immortals and the shore.

Furthermore, possessing a shored body wasn’t the end of it. Someone managed to derive a race’s ultimate power, Chaos. This made primordial immortals seem feeble.

“The apex of the divine beast is Chaos, so is the apex of primordial immortals the high heaven’s power?” Taichu asked.

“You can name it however you want.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Is there a chance of Chaos defeating the high heaven, Sacred Teacher?” The fused being asked. They have exerted their body to the limit yet still lost the previous exchange.

“You are not the high heaven and this body isn’t yours. Do not think it is indicative of the high heaven’s power.” Li Qiye said.

The two agreed that they had overestimated themselves. After all, they were merely wearing the body. Moreover, it might have more potential than they could muster.

“Of course, I am not Chaos either, so who knows which is stronger?” Li Qiye said: “It’s just that I’m using Chaos’ power better than you are with the primordial power. Only when you cultivate it yourself will you know its limit. Anything is possible.”

“What makes you say anything is possible, Sacred Teacher? You have reached the apex with the primordial power previously.” Taichu asked.

“Do you believe this primordial power is the same as the high heaven’s? The divine beasts have the same source too, but is Chaos the same as the high heaven’s? You three are defining what the heavenly power is without seeing it in person.” Li Qiye said.

The three exchanged glances. They had only seen tribulations before but not anything else.

“What was the villainous heaven like?” Evil Transformation asked Fiendish Ground.

“I don’t know, ask Second Brother, wait, Third Brother, he should know best.” Fiendish Ground replied.

“Who among us left?” Evil Transformation asked.

“It’s been too long.” Fiendish Ground said: “First Brother ran first while the villainous heaven trapped all of us. Second and Third Brother managed to get out. Who else got a glimpse?” Fiendish Ground said.

“Fine, then it seems we assumed what the high heaven should be.” Evil Transformation concluded.

“I’m afraid you three won’t be able to see it.” Li Qiye said.

“Sacred Teacher, you are still not Chaos. This derivation is probably not at its true level.” Taichu commented.

“Still not giving up?” Li Qiye smiled.

“Don’t forget about my primordial will.” Taichu said.

“Join the fight then, I’ll wait.” Li Qiye appeared before Taichu, separated by a temporal gap.

“Seniors, we must fuse.” Taichu said.

“You won’t be able to leave once fused.” Evil Transformation said.

Taichu laughed in response: “I’m not leaving this place alive if we lose. Today, being able to wear the shored body will be an honor.”

“Fine, then come, experience the apex.” Fiendish Ground said.

“Sacred Teacher, regardless of the outcome, it was an honor to have met you on my dao path.” Taichu said.

“Alright then, let me see you off. From dust to dust, that’s all.” Li Qiye said.

“This fight will be the highlight of our lives.” The two immortals bowed.

Desolate Ancestor observed with great interest, forgetting about her mission. The next strike might decide it all.

“Buzz.” Taichu glowed brightly before dispersing into primordial particles.

His radiance illuminated all worlds, not just Three Immortals. His tree also dispersed into primordial laws, bringing back the presence of the forgotten age.
